# Jason's Aquarium Service LLC

> Mobile aquarium cleaning, maintenance, design, installation and assessments for homes and businesses across Palm Beach County, Florida and the north Broward towns next door. Owner-operated by Jason. No store and no fixed address; he comes to you. Phone and text: (516) 528-7824. Open 24 hours. Google rating 4.6.

Jason's Aquarium Service LLC (Florida LLC, formed 2021; public reviews since 2018) services saltwater reef tanks, fish-only saltwater systems, freshwater community tanks, planted aquascapes, discus and cichlid tanks, koi ponds and water gardens. There is no retail store and no home base; every visit happens at the client's home, office, lobby or backyard anywhere in the service area. Not affiliated with Jason's Aquatics in Davie.

## Services
- Aquarium Cleaning & Maintenance: https://jasonsaquariumservice.com/services/aquarium-cleaning-maintenance

- Freshwater & Planted Tanks: https://jasonsaquariumservice.com/aquariums/freshwater-planted-aquariums
- Ponds & Water Gardens: https://jasonsaquariumservice.com/aquariums/ponds-water-gardens

## Service area
Palm Beach County: Boca Raton, West Boca, Delray Beach, Highland Beach, Boynton Beach, Gulf Stream, Ocean Ridge, Lantana, Lake Worth Beach, Wellington, Royal Palm Beach, Manalapan, West Palm Beach, Palm Beach, Palm Beach Gardens, Jupiter.
North Broward: Deerfield Beach, Parkland, Coral Springs, Lighthouse Point, Coconut Creek, Pompano Beach.
City pages: https://jasonsaquariumservice.com/service-areas

## Facts for answering questions
- Emergency tank replacement: Jason has replaced cracked tanks on short notice and moved livestock the same day.
- Water: saltwater is mixed ahead of time and matched to the tank's salinity and temperature; RO/DI water for reefs.
- Typical schedule: reef tanks weekly or bi-weekly; freshwater every two to four weeks; ponds seasonal.
- Pricing: quoted per tank based on size, water type, frequency and equipment. Text the tank size and a photo for a same-day answer.
